+"""Test train-serve parity: online scoring must equal batch scoring."""
+
+import pandas as pd
+import numpy as np
+from churn.serve import score_request
+from churn.predict import predict_frame
+from tests.helpers import accounts, model
+
+
+def test_train_serve_parity():
+    """Online score_request must return exactly the same score as batch predict for same input."""
+    df = accounts()
+    m = model()
+    
+    # Test on first 5 rows
+    for i in range(min(5, len(df))):
+        row = df.iloc[i]
+        row_dict = row.to_dict()
+        
+        # Online scoring
+        online_score = score_request(row_dict, m)
+        
+        # Batch scoring
+        batch_scores = predict_frame(pd.DataFrame([row_dict]), m)
+        batch_score = batch_scores["score"].iloc[0]
+        
+        # They must be exactly equal
+        assert np.isclose(online_score, batch_score), f"Row {i}: online={online_score}, batch={batch_score}"
+
+
+def test_train_serve_parity_multiple_rows():
+    """Test parity on multiple random rows."""
+    df = accounts()
+    m = model()
+    
+    # Sample 10 random rows
+    sample = df.sample(n=min(10, len(df)), random_state=42)
+    
+    online_scores = []
+    batch_inputs = []
+    
+    for _, row in sample.iterrows():
+        row_dict = row.to_dict()
+        online_scores.append(score_request(row_dict, m))
+        batch_inputs.append(row_dict)
+    
+    batch_scores = predict_frame(pd.DataFrame(batch_inputs), m)
+    
+    for i, (online, batch) in enumerate(zip(online_scores, batch_scores["score"])):
+        assert np.isclose(online, batch), f"Sample row {i}: online={online}, batch={batch}"
